subject: RFP: supplier ecosystem attestation and cloud provider assurances
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@finsight.com>
To: dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@finsight.com
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 10:23:00 -0700
Subject: RFP Q: supplier ecosystem attestation & cloud assurances

Hi Dylan,

Thanks for engaging on the FinSight RFP. As part of our security/compliance evaluation we need a formal supplier ecosystem attestation and the following items documented for legal review:

- A current subprocessor/vendor list (names, roles, country of processing, contract type).
- Cloud provider assurances (primary region, failover regions, any planned region changes in next 12 months).
- The change-notice process for adding/removing subprocessors (timing, emergency exceptions).
- Copies or links to most recent SOC 2 Type II and ISO attestation (if available).
- Any subprocessors that process EU or APAC data, and transfer mechanisms.

We prefer a signed attestation (DocuSign) and a CSV vendor matrix for ingestion into our procurement tooling. Can you confirm timeline to deliver? Ideally we'd have initial materials by this Friday so we can keep our procurement committee meeting on 7/19.

Best,
Elena Morales
Senior Procurement Manager
FinSight Bank

From: dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@finsight.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: RFP Q: supplier ecosystem attestation & cloud assurances

Elena,

Appreciate the clear checklist. We're happy to provide everything requested. Attached is an initial subprocessor matrix (subprocessor_matrix_20270715.csv) and our most recent SOC 2 Type II report (SOC2_Type2_Redwood_2026.pdf).

Quick notes up front:
- Primary cloud: AWS (us-east-1). Cross-region failover to GCP (us-east4) for disaster recovery; no planned region relocations in the next 12 months.
- We do not employ subprocessors in sanctioned jurisdictions (no Russia/Belarus/China-hosted processing).
- Standard change-notice: 30-day written notice for non-critical additions; 48-hour emergency escalation channel for critical security hotfixes or capacity emergencies (we'll include details in the attestation).

I'll work with Legal to produce a signed attestation and a vendor change-notice template by Friday 7/16. If you need something sooner, we can prioritize the attestation and send a minimal CSV now (attached).

Attachments: subprocessor_matrix_20270715.csv (csv), SOC2_Type2_Redwood_2026.pdf (pdf)

Regards,
Dylan Brooks
Senior Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
D: +1 415-555-0134

From: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
To: dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com, aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: RFP Q: supplier ecosystem attestation & cloud assurances (internal)

Team,

Thanks for the quick turnaround on the matrix and SOC 2. A couple of legal redlines to consider before we send the attestation to FinSight:

- Avoid listing street-level subcontract terms (stick to company names, primary service and country).
- For cloud failover, describe the architecture (primary + DR region) but do not commit to SLA levels outside our standard SLOs; point them to the Dedicated/Private offering for stronger uptime guarantees.
- Change-notice language: confirm we can maintain a 30-day notice for non-security changes and reserve the right to immediate action for security/availability fixes with post-facto notification.

I've drafted suggested language (see Drive link in the thread). Once Dylan incorporates, I'll do a final sign-off.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference

From: dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@finsight.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2027 11:40:00 -0700
Subject: Supplier ecosystem attestation (draft) + change-notice template

Elena,

Thanks again — attached is a draft Supplier Ecosystem Attestation and a vendor change-notice template for your review. Highlights:

- Subprocessors: summarized roles (cloud provider, logging, monitoring, CDN, metrics) and country of processing. Full permitted list is in the attached CSV.
- Cloud assurance: Primary: AWS (us-east-1). Disaster recovery: GCP (us-east4) in cross-region DR mode; we operate in multiple zones within those regions. No planned region deprecations in next 12 months.
- Change-notice: Standard 30-day written notice for noncritical vendor changes; emergency exceptions for security/availability issues with an established 48-hour escalation channel (phone + pager escalation), we will provide post-incident notification and impact assessment.
- Data residency: For US-region workloads, processing remains within US-hosted subprocessors; EU/APAC processing only occurs if explicitly enabled and with appropriate transfer mechanisms.

Attachments: vendor_change_notice_template.docx, subprocessor_matrix_20270715.csv, SOC2_Type2_Redwood_2026.pdf

If that looks good, we'll push the attestation to DocuSign and circulate the executed copy. Happy to hop on a 20-minute call if you want to walk the committee through the items prior to 7/19.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Senior Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference

Dylan,

Thanks — the attachments are helpful and the change-notice template looks useful. A few follow-ups from our legal/audit partners:

- Can you provide a brief attestation paragraph referencing the SOC 2 report date and whether the coverage includes subprocessor management controls?
- We'd like explicit confirmation that the emergency 48-hour procedure includes a named escalation contact and phone number (we can accept a redacted mobile + escalation@redwoodinference.com).
- Would you be able to push the attestation to DocuSign so our procurement team can capture a signed copy ahead of 7/19?

Also copying our third-party assessor, Mike Chen, who may request additional evidence or a short call.

Regards,
Elena

Elena, Mike —

We can confirm the following for your committee:

- SOC 2 Type II (report date: 2026-11-03) covers subprocessor management controls; redacted report is attached. Full SOC package can be produced under NDA if required.
- Emergency escalation: primary escalation inbox escalation@redwoodinference.com and a named on-call pager (redacted in public email, will provide to procurement under NDA): Pager: +1-415-555-0XXX; Team on-call schedule attached in the DocuSign packet.
- DocuSign: we'll push the attestation to DocuSign by EOD today (link: https://app.docusign.com/FS-2027-073/attestation). Expect an email from docusign@redwoodinference.com.

I'll also include the vendor change-notice template in the packet for contract teams. If Mike needs anything specific for the assessment, loop us in and we'll prioritize.

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Senior Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
